run.note: Reconstructed after the fact from the per-trajectory `run` stamps and start times: before launch history was recorded, every launch (and every `evaluate`/`index`) overwrote this file. The directory was named main2 at generation time. The 2,395 Gemma 4 and Qwen3 D0-D5 trajectories are stamped with a Luna-only D0-D3 config written by an `evaluate` at about 08:44 UTC while the first launch was still starting jobs; they were generated by the first launch. The two small later launches re-ran individual tasks (2 Qwen3, 1 Haiku D7). The repeated Haiku D0 run has its own config in rerun/.
